title: China-to-Chile Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: SEC Electrical Safety Certification and NCh IEC 62841
rows.target_requirement: Chile requires SEC (Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles) certification for controlled electrical products before they can be sold or imported. Approval is obtained through a SEC-authorized certification body against the applicable Chilean NCh standards, which adopt IEC text; for hand-held and transportable motor-operated tools the relevant family is the NCh IEC 62841 series. The product receives a SEC certificate and seal. Chilean mains are 220 V, 50 Hz single phase, so the tool and any plug must suit Chilean supply.
target_standards: SEC mandatory certification regime for controlled electrical products (Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles)
NCh IEC 62841 series (adopted via INN) for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden electric tools
SEC certification issued through a SEC-authorized certification body and laboratory
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series (hand-held motor-operated electric tools) and use CCC where the product falls in a CCC-listed category. GB/T 3883 reports do not by themselves grant the SEC certificate or seal and must be re-evaluated against the Chilean NCh IEC 62841 edition by an authorized certifier.
china_standards: CCC (China Compulsory Certification) where the product is in a CCC-listed category
rows.gap: The main gap is treating a GB/T 3883 or CCC file as sufficient for Chile. SEC certification is a separate national approval issued by an authorized certifier against the Chilean NCh IEC 62841 edition, with its own certificate, seal, and importer-side registration. The tool must also suit the Chilean 220 V 50 Hz single-phase plug and supply.

target.en: Mandatory: SEC certification for controlled electrical products against the applicable NCh IEC standard before sale or import in Chile. The NCh IEC 62841 series is the technical basis the certifier applies.
target.zh: 强制：受控电气产品在智利销售或进口前须按适用 NCh IEC 标准取得 SEC 认证。NCh IEC 62841 系列是认证机构适用的技术基础。
target.zht: 強制：受控電氣產品在智利銷售或進口前須按適用 NCh IEC 標準取得 SEC 認證。NCh IEC 62841 系列是認證機構適用的技術基礎。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where the product is in a CCC-listed category.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，属于 CCC 目录类别时使用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，屬於 CCC 目錄類別時使用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Chile-ready as-is if the file only contains GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence. SEC certification through an authorized certifier against the Chilean NCh IEC 62841 edition is required, with a 220 V 50 Hz single-phase supply and plug suited to Chile.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles (SEC), Chile

rows.requirement: SUBTEL Radio Approval and EMC Treatment for Cordless Tools
rows.target_requirement: Chile does not operate a single EU-style horizontal EMC directive for all apparatus. Radio modules in cordless tools, such as Bluetooth pairing, app connectivity, or wireless chargers, fall under SUBTEL (Subsecretaria de Telecomunicaciones) type approval before sale or import. Where a tool is a controlled electrical product, its electrical safety stays under SEC; SUBTEL handles the spectrum and radio side. EMC is addressed through SUBTEL technical conditions for radio equipment rather than a stand-alone national EMC act covering every motor tool.
target_standards: SUBTEL (Subsecretaria de Telecomunicaciones) type approval for radio-transmitting equipment
SUBTEL technical conditions and resolutions for radio modules (for example Bluetooth or wireless charging in cordless tools)
SEC electrical certification remains the route for tool electrical safety
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports, and SRRC type approval for embedded radio modules. SRRC and China EMC evidence do not substitute for SUBTEL Chilean type approval, which has its own application, local representative, and labelling expectations.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
SRRC type approval for embedded radio modules where applicable
rows.gap: Exporters often assume a single EMC certificate clears Chile. In practice the split is by authority: SEC for electrical safety, SUBTEL for any radio module. A cordless tool with wireless features needs SUBTEL type approval; a corded tool with no radio module has no direct equivalent to the EU horizontal EMC directive and should be cleared mainly through SEC plus contractual or buyer EMC expectations.

target.en: Mandatory: SUBTEL type approval for radio-transmitting modules before sale or import. Chile has no single horizontal EMC act for all non-radio motor tools equivalent to the EU EMC Directive; EMC for non-radio tools is largely a contractual or buyer-driven expectation rather than a stand-alone national mandate.
target.zh: 强制：无线电发射模块在销售或进口前须取得 SUBTEL 型号核准。智利没有针对所有非无线电电机工具、等同于欧盟 EMC 指令的单一横向 EMC 法案；非无线电工具的 EMC 主要是合同或买方驱动的期望，而非独立的国家强制要求。
target.zht: 強制：無線電發射模組在銷售或進口前須取得 SUBTEL 型號核准。智利沒有針對所有非無線電電機工具、等同於歐盟 EMC 指令的單一橫向 EMC 法案；非無線電工具的 EMC 主要是合同或買方驅動的期望，而非獨立的國家強制要求。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence and SRRC, but Chilean acceptance depends on SUBTEL type approval for radio and SEC for safety.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据和 SRRC，但智利接受性取决于无线电的 SUBTEL 型号核准和安全的 SEC 认证。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據和 SRRC，但智利接受性取決於無線電的 SUBTEL 型號核准和安全的 SEC 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For cordless tools with radio modules, not Chile-ready until SUBTEL type approval is obtained and SEC electrical certification is in place. For corded tools with no radio module, there is no direct Chilean equivalent to the EU horizontal EMC directive, and clearance runs mainly through SEC.

rows.requirement: Market Access and Import Clearance Under SEC Control
rows.target_requirement: To place corded or cordless power tools on the Chilean market, the product must hold valid SEC certification for its controlled electrical category and carry the SEC seal, with the certificate traceable to a SEC-authorized certifier. INN publishes the NCh standards (adopting IEC) that the certifier applies. Importers clear customs at ports such as Valparaiso or San Antonio, and SEC documentation is part of lawful sale. There is no single CE-style self-declaration mark; approval is certifier-issued, not manufacturer self-declared.
target_standards: SEC certification and seal as a condition for placing controlled electrical products on the Chilean market
INN NCh standards (adopting IEC) applied by the authorized certifier
Chilean customs import clearance (ports of Valparaiso and San Antonio)
rows.china_equivalent: China market files commonly rely on the GB/T 3883 series and, where listed, CCC marking for domestic placement. CCC and GB/T evidence support Chinese market access but do not constitute SEC certification, the SEC seal, or Chilean import documentation.
china_standards: CCC marking where the product is in a CCC-listed category
rows.gap: A China domestic CCC or GB/T file is not enough for Chilean placement. The importer needs a valid SEC certificate from an authorized certifier, the SEC seal on product or packaging, NCh IEC 62841 alignment, and correct customs documentation. Unlike the EU, Chile uses third-party certifier approval rather than a manufacturer self-declared CE mark.

target.en: Mandatory: valid SEC certification and seal for the controlled electrical category before sale or import in Chile, issued by a SEC-authorized certifier against the applicable NCh IEC standard. There is no CE-style self-declaration route.
target.zh: 强制：受控电气类别在智利销售或进口前须持有有效 SEC 认证和标志，由 SEC 授权认证机构按适用 NCh IEC 标准签发。没有 CE 式自我声明路径。
target.zht: 強制：受控電氣類別在智利銷售或進口前須持有有效 SEC 認證和標誌，由 SEC 授權認證機構按適用 NCh IEC 標準簽發。沒有 CE 式自我聲明路徑。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where the product is CCC-listed.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，属于 CCC 目录时使用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，屬於 CCC 目錄時使用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Chile-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence. A SEC certificate, SEC seal, NCh IEC 62841 alignment, and Chilean import documentation are required; Chile uses certifier approval, not a self-declared CE mark.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles (SEC), Chile

rows.requirement: Noise Handling and the Absence of EU-Style Outdoor-Noise Marking
rows.target_requirement: Chile does not operate an EU-style horizontal outdoor-noise marking regime equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC for power tools placed on the market. There is no national requirement for a guaranteed sound-power-level marking or LWA label on the tool as a market-access condition. Noise in Chile is treated mainly through environmental and occupational frameworks, such as workplace noise-exposure limits enforced by health and labour authorities, rather than a product-level outdoor-noise marking. Exporters should not claim a Chilean outdoor-noise marking, because none exists.
target_standards: No Chilean equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise marking for power tools at market-access level
Chilean occupational and environmental noise rules (workplace noise-exposure limits, environmental noise norms) as the relevant context rather than product marking
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may report a declared noise value, but it does not constitute a Chilean outdoor-noise marking. China likewise has no obligation equivalent to a SEC-mandated outdoor-noise product label; noise is mostly handled through occupational exposure and environmental standards.
china_standards: China occupational and environmental noise standards where applicable
rows.gap: There is no Chilean product-level outdoor-noise marking to comply with, so the honest position is that this EU-style requirement does not transfer. The practical action is not to fabricate a Chilean noise mark, to keep any declared noise value consistent with the GB/T file, and to verify workplace and environmental noise rules separately if the tool is used in regulated worksites.

target.en: Not applicable as a product market-access marking: Chile has no EU-style outdoor-noise marking obligation for power tools. Occupational and environmental noise rules may apply to the use of the tool but are not a product-level certification mark.
target.zh: 作为产品市场准入标识不适用：智利对电动工具没有欧盟式户外噪声标识义务。职业和环境噪声规定可能适用于工具的使用，但不是产品级认证标志。
target.zht: 作為產品市場准入標識不適用：智利對電動工具沒有歐盟式戶外噪聲標識義務。職業和環境噪聲規定可能適用於工具的使用，但不是產品級認證標誌。

cn.en: China has no product-level outdoor-noise marking equivalent either; noise is handled through occupational and environmental standards.
cn.zh: 中国同样没有产品级户外噪声标识对应要求；噪声通过职业和环境标准处理。
cn.zht: 中國同樣沒有產品級戶外噪聲標識對應要求；噪聲通過職業和環境標準處理。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Chilean outdoor-noise product marking applies, so there is nothing to certify at market-access level. Do not claim a Chilean noise mark; keep declared noise values consistent with the source file and check occupational or environmental noise rules separately for use contexts.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles (SEC), Chile

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances and the Absence of EU-Style RoHS
rows.target_requirement: Chile does not operate a horizontal RoHS-type restricted-substance regime for electrical and electronic equipment equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU as a market-access condition for power tools. SEC certification focuses on electrical and mechanical safety, not homogeneous-material substance limits. Substance controls in Chile arise through chemical, waste, and import rules rather than a tool-level RoHS declaration, so there is no Chilean RoHS mark to obtain for the tool itself.
target_standards: No Chilean equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU (RoHS) as a market-access condition for power tools
Chilean chemical, hazardous-substance, and waste rules as the general context rather than a tool-level RoHS declaration
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files use the GB/T 3883 series for safety and may include China RoHS material declarations (the SJ/T China RoHS management measures and marking) where the product is in scope. China RoHS evidence supports material disclosure but is not a Chilean requirement and does not map to a Chilean RoHS mark.
china_standards: China RoHS management measures and marking where applicable
rows.gap: There is no Chilean tool-level RoHS mark to comply with, so the EU RoHS requirement does not transfer to Chile as a market-access obligation. The honest position is to state that Chile has no RoHS regime for the tool, avoid implying a Chilean RoHS approval, and keep any China RoHS or buyer substance declarations as contractual or buyer-driven evidence only.

target.en: Not applicable as a tool-level market-access requirement: Chile has no EU-style RoHS regime for power tools. General chemical and waste rules may apply but are not a product RoHS declaration or mark.
target.zh: 作为工具级市场准入要求不适用：智利对电动工具没有欧盟式 RoHS 制度。一般化学品和废物规则可能适用，但不是产品 RoHS 声明或标志。
target.zht: 作為工具級市場准入要求不適用：智利對電動工具沒有歐盟式 RoHS 制度。一般化學品和廢物規則可能適用，但不是產品 RoHS 聲明或標誌。

cn.en: China RoHS material declaration may apply domestically but is not a Chilean obligation.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 材料声明在境内可能适用，但不是智利义务。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 材料聲明在境內可能適用，但不是智利義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No Chilean RoHS-style tool-level substance regime applies, so there is no Chilean RoHS mark to obtain. Do not imply a Chilean RoHS approval; treat China RoHS or buyer substance declarations as contractual evidence only.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles (SEC), Chile

rows.requirement: Battery Treatment for Cordless Tools and the Absence of EU Battery Regulation
rows.target_requirement: Chile has no single EU-style battery regulation equivalent to Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 governing conformity assessment, CE battery marking, removability, due diligence, and battery passport for portable batteries in cordless tools. The lithium battery pack is treated mainly through SEC product safety where the pack or charger is a controlled electrical product, plus general import, dangerous-goods transport, and waste rules. There is no Chilean battery passport or producer-responsibility battery mark equivalent to the EU regime as a market-access condition.
target_standards: No Chilean equivalent to EU Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 battery regime as a market-access condition for cordless-tool batteries
SEC product safety where the battery pack or charger is a controlled electrical product
Chilean import, dangerous-goods transport, and waste rules for lithium batteries as general context
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, plus separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence such as GB 31241 and UN 38.3. This supports safety and shipment but does not map to a broad EU-style battery economic-operator and passport regime, which Chile also does not impose.
china_standards: GB 31241 lithium battery safety where applicable
UN 38.3 lithium battery transport evidence where applicable
rows.gap: Cordless tools do not face an EU-style battery regulation in Chile, so the broad battery passport, removability, and due-diligence duties do not transfer. The realistic gap is narrower: ensure the battery pack or charger meets SEC product safety where it is a controlled electrical product, keep lithium transport evidence such as UN 38.3 for shipment, and do not claim a Chilean battery conformity mark that does not exist.

target.en: Not applicable as an EU-style battery regulation: Chile has no Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 equivalent. Mandatory elements are limited to SEC product safety where the pack or charger is a controlled electrical product, plus general import and dangerous-goods transport rules.
target.zh: 作为欧盟式电池法规不适用：智利没有法规（EU）2023/1542 的对应制度。强制内容限于电池包或充电器属于受控电气产品时的 SEC 产品安全，外加一般进口和危险品运输规则。
target.zht: 作為歐盟式電池法規不適用：智利沒有法規（EU）2023/1542 的對應制度。強制內容限於電池包或充電器屬於受控電氣產品時的 SEC 產品安全，外加一般進口和危險品運輸規則。

cn.en: China uses GB/T 3883 for tools and GB 31241 or UN 38.3 for battery safety and transport, which does not constitute a Chilean battery regime.
cn.zh: 中国对工具采用 GB/T 3883，对电池安全和运输采用 GB 31241 或 UN 38.3，这不构成智利电池制度。
cn.zht: 中國對工具採用 GB/T 3883，對電池安全和運輸採用 GB 31241 或 UN 38.3，這不構成智利電池制度。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style battery regulation applies to cordless-tool batteries in Chile. Ensure SEC product safety for any controlled pack or charger, keep UN 38.3 transport evidence for shipment, and do not claim a Chilean battery conformity mark that does not exist.

source.publisher: Superintendencia de Electricidad y Combustibles (SEC), Chile
